SelenEkto portable Windows application

Double-click SelenEkto.exe. No PowerShell or Git required.
Terrain statistics work only where processed profiles exist.
Full-resolution per-pixel analysis requires NASA GeoTIFFs in data/raw/lola/<region>/.
Place the portable folder somewhere writable (for example Documents), not Program Files.
This build excludes large raw TIFFs by design.
If the app fails, inspect data/processed/logs/release_startup_error.log.
